shared_fields.values: Full document; verified fact bundle; executable fixture; constructed mathematical instance; fictional situation record; actual transcript.

shared_fields.values: Real sourced / explicitly fictional / abstract formal.
shared_fields.precondition: Do not mix invented events with claims of real-world truth. Fictional records must be framed as supplied scenarios; real claims retain their evidence and dates.
shared_fields.diversity: Controls validity; not a novelty multiplier.

shared_fields.values: Named place from a sourced record; or fictional venue with settlement type, indoor/outdoor and capacity.
shared_fields.include_when: Planning, travel, local services, settings or evidence that actually depends on place.
shared_fields.precondition: Real country, timezone, currency and route facts must agree and be sourced when material. A Greek prompt may concern any location. Do not invent local laws, schedules or distances.
shared_fields.diversity: A setting change is cosmetic unless it changes constraints or evidence.

shared_fields.values: Absolute anchor date; ordered event dates; time windows; duration; timezone when relevant.
shared_fields.include_when: Any deadline, schedule, historical fact or update.
shared_fields.precondition: Derive weekdays from dates and end times from start plus duration. Deadline precedes event unless an intentional documented conflict. Resolve “tomorrow” against the anchor.
shared_fields.diversity: New answer-bearing schedules count as instances, not automatically new structures.

shared_fields.values: Positive total; roles; optional non-overlapping age bands; optional gender counts. Group-size domains belong to each recipe.
shared_fields.include_when: People counts affect a calculation, capacity, audience or social situation.
shared_fields.precondition: Counts are nonnegative integers; mutually exclusive counts sum to total; overlapping categories are marked. Do not assume only men and women unless the scenario explicitly makes that exhaustive.
shared_fields.diversity: Counts matter when they affect the task; names and demographic swaps alone do not.

shared_fields.values: Exact fictional age or age band; unknown/unspecified allowed.
shared_fields.include_when: Age affects audience comprehension, stated eligibility, supervision or the requested content.
shared_fields.precondition: Age is measured at the anchor date if needed; role and event eligibility must be compatible. Do not infer ability, attitude or preferences from age. Preserve source ages.
shared_fields.diversity: Conditional contextual variable, not an automatic persona field.

shared_fields.values: Specified self-description, fictional group counts, or unspecified.
shared_fields.include_when: Source says it, the user asks about it, or the task actually uses it.
shared_fields.precondition: No inference from name, job or topic. Do not attach competence or tone to gender. Omit irrelevant gender; validate counts without assuming binary exhaustiveness.
shared_fields.diversity: Optional attribute; demographic permutations are not independent problem types.

shared_fields.values: Task role; domain knowledge; immediate goal; known information; available resources; optionally relevant personal constraints.
shared_fields.include_when: Every synthetic seed has an internal user role and goal; disclose only what the request needs.
shared_fields.precondition: Distinguish the person asking from participants described in a document and from the intended audience. Knowledge and resources are explicit, not inferred from demographics.
shared_fields.diversity: Different goals or information states can change the task; biographies alone do not.

shared_fields.values: Self; colleague; customer; public; learner; child; specialist; plus explicitly chosen prior knowledge.
shared_fields.include_when: Writing, explanation, translation, planning communication or summarisation.
shared_fields.precondition: Audience may differ from the user. Reading level, terms and desired detail must fit the selected purpose; no need to prepend an artificial persona biography.
shared_fields.diversity: Changes useful answer requirements when genuinely relevant.

shared_fields.values: Money in integer minor units; currency; stock; equipment; time; capacity; permissions.
shared_fields.include_when: Planning, troubleshooting, arithmetic, tools or constraint-based tasks.
shared_fields.precondition: Units are typed and consistent. Derive totals, available time and feasibility. If intentionally infeasible, freeze the contradiction and expected response in curator metadata.

shared_fields.values: Atomic claims with IDs, source spans, dates, certainty and dependencies; protected facts and distractors tagged.
shared_fields.include_when: Source-based tasks, factual questions and generated documents.
shared_fields.precondition: Freeze truth status before generation. Missing information is genuinely absent, not fabricated; conflicting records preserve attribution and chronology.
shared_fields.diversity: Evidence and dependency patterns are structural.

shared_fields.values: Operation; requested output; necessary inputs; unknowns; success criteria; primary purpose and secondary skills.
shared_fields.precondition: Choose operation before selecting compatible content. IF inherits the underlying summarise/edit/extract/translate/plan task requirements. No generic “make a task about X” packet.

shared_fields.values: Atomic format, length, preservation, exclusion, ordering and conditional rules.
shared_fields.include_when: IF, plus secondary constraints in other purposes.
shared_fields.precondition: Bind preservation rules to actual fact/span IDs. Build a satisfiable output witness for hard constraints. Check JSON/bullet/word-count rules with language-appropriate validators; distinguish intentional conflict tasks.
shared_fields.diversity: Vary constraint types and interactions, not just number of bullets.

shared_fields.values: Routine / compositional / challenging, using family definitions.
shared_fields.precondition: Measure dependency depth, ambiguity, competing evidence and interacting constraints. Wordiness, age and topic labels are not difficulty. Recalibrate with target-model outcomes.

shared_fields.values: el/en/fr/de/es/it/pt; source language separately; translation direction when relevant.
shared_fields.precondition: Assign target quotas independently of task selection subject to compatibility. Preserve real names and values; adaptation may change only permitted cultural details. Greeklish is Greek-only.
shared_fields.diversity: Surface dimension; same underlying instance across languages is a labelled parallel.

shared_fields.values: Cooperative / frustrated / skeptical / playful; register standard/informal/formal/Greeklish.
shared_fields.include_when: Synthetic user wording. Natural forum wording is preserved.
shared_fields.precondition: Attitude must leave the task, evidence and intent unchanged. Frustration needs a plausible reason if stated. Do not correlate with gender, nationality or task difficulty.
shared_fields.diversity: Surface diversity, not independent task novelty.

shared_fields.values: Actual target-model assistant turns plus user turns and structured dialogue state.
shared_fields.precondition: Freeze checkpoint and sampling settings, keep all assistant turns unedited, record pending constraints and what each party knows. A recovery case needs a verified actual error.
shared_fields.diversity: Interaction trajectories; paraphrased histories are not new recoveries.

shared_fields.precondition: Never put private solutions, hidden truth labels or review rubrics into model-facing requests. Generation may receive the facts needed to write the request; evaluate separately.

additional_preconditions: Reserve 35% of the programme; execute after single-turn task seeds are ready.
Use any compatible underlying task recipe and carry its facts/resources/constraints into state.
Sol writes user turns from actual history. Only Apertus writes assistant turns.
Error recovery requires a verified model error; resisting false correction requires a correct answer being challenged. Unreached goals are not counted as successes.

workflow: Allocate exact task/family/difficulty slots; credit accepted forum requests first. Assign language and attitude quotas separately with compatibility constraints.
Choose a reviewed task structure and a content route. Select an existing document, verified fact bundle, formal fixture or fictional situation schema.
Select only relevant shared fields. Sample independent root values from bounded catalogues; derive dependent values and reject contradictions.
Freeze complete content. Existing sources keep their facts. Synthetic documents are authored from concrete records, checked for invented/omitted facts, then frozen.
Resolve the requested operation and constraints against that content. Construct a private answer/rubric and a feasibility witness where applicable.
Reserve content-family, structure and canonical instance keys across the programme; keep related sources, translations and variants in one split.
Send a batch of complete packets to Sol for natural user wording. Do not let it invent answer-bearing information to fill gaps.
Validate fidelity, direct-request form, language, premise annotation and duplicate status. Count accepted prompts only; refill the same quota cell.

diversity: Null is a deliberate choice: do not insert a location, age, gender or biography into every seed.
Track task × difficulty, task × topic, language × task and structure reuse in accepted outputs; marginal totals alone can hide clustering.
Meaningful instance hash includes operation, evidence/relationships, answer-bearing values and canonical source content; exclude wording and cosmetic names.
Changing names, gender or town labels does not create new structures. A new document with the same fact/constraint pattern still shares that structure.
Use hard exact-duplicate checks and reviewed structure caps; semantic diversity and realism still need review. Do not claim an absolute semantic guarantee.
Do not multiply every catalogue size: valid capacity is the count satisfying compatibility, sufficient sources and reuse limits. Recalculate capacity after those inventories exist.
